name: Anonymous dynamic image and public GET discovery
admission: Fresh failures select exact unknown unprotected hosts under an already learned parent. The disposable owned browser uses no user profile, cookies, headers or storage.
discovery: Images retain V3 DOM discovery. Public JSON candidates must correlate Fetch/XHR GET request and HTTP200 application/json response with the same request ID and URL. At most64 pending request IDs; select largest declared bounded object; URLs stay transient. No interactions or login.
proof: Discovery grants no route. Anonymous identity GET probes require bounded unambiguous Content-Length, complete JSON object/array, and equal length plus strong validator or fixed-prefix binding. Independent system, app-DNS and two local-strategy failures must precede owned completion; any complete local response vetoes Geph.
legacy: V1/V2/V3 parsers remain strict; V3 does not accept asset_kind or JSON discovery. Range200 JSON remains unknown.
